title: Universal Orbit Map
description: Count total orbits in a tree, then find the shortest transfer path between two nodes.
writeup:
## Approach

The orbit map is a tree rooted at `COM`. Parse each `A)B` line into a parent lookup (`B -> A`) and an adjacency list.

## Part 1

The total number of direct + indirect orbits equals the sum of each node's depth in the tree. Compute depth recursively with memoization: `depth(node) = 1 + depth(parent[node])`, base case `depth(COM) = 0`.

## Part 2

Find the minimum orbital transfers between the objects `YOU` and `SAN` orbit. This is the shortest path in the undirected orbit graph, easily found with BFS. Equivalently, walk both nodes up to their lowest common ancestor and sum the distances — the path goes up from one and back down to the other.
